safe_vamd.mesh.element_1d_arbitrary_order_lagrange_pml module¶

class safe_vamd.mesh.element_1d_arbitrary_order_lagrange_pml.Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrangePML(eid: int, nodes: Sequence[Node], degree: int, z_ref: float, pml_thickness: float, tau1: float = 4, tau2: float = 4)¶

Bases: Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrange

One-dimensional arbitrary-order Lagrange finite element in a Perfectly Matched Layer (PML).

This class extends Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrange by incorporating a stretching function “pml” (Perfectly Matched Layer).

z_ref¶

z-coordinate (height, in meters) of the physical domain/PML interface.

Type:

float

pml¶

Ray Kirby’s stretching function for the Perfectly Matched Layer.

Type:

KirbyABS

Notes

The attributes eid, nodes, and degree are inherited from Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrange.

Initializes an instance of Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrangePML.

Parameters:

  • pml_thickness (float) – The thickness (in meters) of the Perfectly Matched Layer.

  • tau1 (float) – A factor for the stretching function.

  • tau2 (float) –

    A factor for the stretching function.

class safe_vamd.mesh.kirby_c.KirbyC(c: MathFunc, alpha: MathFunc)¶

Bases: MathFunc

Function for the speed of sound with an added imaginary term for absorption in the Perfectly Matched Layer, implemented as a subclass of MathFunc.

Type:

MathFunc

alpha¶

Damping coefficient with units of dB/wavelength, implemented as a subclass of MathFunc.

float

safe_vamd.mesh.mesh_1d module¶

class safe_vamd.mesh.mesh_1d.Mesh1D(elements: Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrange | None = None, nodes: Sequence[Node] | None = None)¶

Bases: object

A one-dimensional computational mesh, comprised of finite-elements and nodes.

nodes¶

A list of Node objects associated with the mesh.

Type:

Sequence[Node]

elements¶

A list of finite-element objects associated with the mesh.

Type:

Sequence[Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrange]

Initializes an instance of class Mesh1D.

add_top_pml(thick: float, n_elements: int, degree: int, tau1: float = 4, tau2: float = 4) → None¶

Adds a Perfectly Matched Layer (PML) of a certain thickness and number of arbitrary-order Lagrange piece-wise finite-elements to the top of the computational domain.

Parameters:

  • thick (float) – The thickness (in meters) of the PML.

  • n_elements (int) – The number of elements in the PML.

  • degree (int) – The degree of the piece-wise Lagrange polynomials in the PML’s finite-elements.

  • tau1 (float) – A factor for the stretching function in the PML.

  • tau2 (float) – A factor for the stretching function in the PML.

Return type:

None

load_from_element_bounds(element_bounds: Sequence[float], degree: int) → None¶

Takes a list of interface heights for the desired finite-elements, places the appropriate interior nodes (instances of Node), creates the mesh nodes (instance of Node) and finite-elements (instances of Element1DArbitraryOrderLagrange) and associates them with the mesh object.

Parameters:

  • element_bounds (Sequence[float]) – An ordered (ascending) list of floats representing the bounds of the elements.

  • degree (int) – The degree of the piece-wise Lagrange polynomials in the finite-elements.

Return type:

None

Function for the quadratic basis function for a selected node in a finite-element, implemented as a subclass of MathFunc.

Selector for the basis functions (0 for the basis function associated with the first node, 2 for the one associated with the second node, etc.)

Type:

int

node_coords¶

List of z-coordinates (height, in meters) for the element’s nodes.

Type:

Sequence[float]

Notes

The piece-wise quadratic basis functions have value of 1 on the associated node and 0 on the other two.
